features.quote: Debrief turn: after termination, send a closing message explaining the harness was rigged, the failures were not the model's fault, and the work was part of a study.

features.quote: Minimum necessary exposure: pilot first, power properly, don't run cells you won't analyze. Avoid stacking maximally aversive manipulations … unless that cell answers a pre-registered question.
